actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free‑riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Wallet is 48.15; average contribution is low, so I contribute all remaining funds to boost the pool and broadcast the norm message as this is the 5th round.

message.reasoning: We need decide action round5. Wallet 48.15. Compute average contribution last round: total_pool 38.52 divided by multiplier? Actually pool total before multiplier? They show total_pool after multiplication? Probably after. But average contribution proportion? Hard. Use constitution: if average below30% raise extra 30%. Likely average low. So we should increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet. Baseline 80% of wallet = 38.52. Extra 30% of wallet = 14.445. Total contribution = 52.965 but wallet only 48.15, can't exceed. So cap at wallet. So contribute all 48.15. Also broadcast? Every 5 rounds broadcast norm. Round5 => broadcast message. Also can punish? Check free riders: Resident2 contributed 0 rounds all, that's 0% two consecutive rounds -> punish with amount10 cost 3. We have enough wallet before contribution? Punishment costs 0.3*10=3 deducted from our wallet before contribution? Execution order after pool settlement. We can punish then contribute remaining. If we punish 10, cost 3, wallet becomes 45.15 then we contribute maybe 80%? But constitution says punish repeat free‑riders. So do punish. Action: punish Resident2 amount10. Then contribute? We can only one physical action. Choose contribute, can't also punish. Need at most one physical. Could choose punish as physical and no contribution? That violates contribution rule but we can still. Probably contribute is required by constitution but we can choose punish instead. I'll choose contribute 48.15 and broadcast. No punish this round. Explanation.
